description: SDKs for letting AI agents buy within a passkey-signed mandate on PayPal, with offline-verifiable receipts.
rules: Every POST is idempotent: the SDK sends one Idempotency-Key per call and reuses it on retries.
Never countersign again after OutcomeUnknownError; wait for the purchase instead.
Payments run on the PayPal sandbox; no real money moves.
